verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI's docs say transcripts can come back 'already cleaned up and formatted' based on formatting instructions you send with the audio, and that output is 'ready to send'. That shows a first-party formatting capability. The pack never names punctuation, casing, or number formatting specifically, and never documents a way to turn formatting off. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of punctuation, casing and number/inverse-text normalization; a documented toggle to disable formatting; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, transcripts come back with punctuation, casing, and number formatting applied, and I can turn the formatting off

citations.quote: You include formatting instructions with your audio, and the transcript comes back already cleaned up and formatted.
it returns text that is ready to send: filler gone, self-corrections resolved, names spelled right.
